lines: Policy update We updated our Privacy Policy on April 7, 2025. [View our previous policy.](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/version/8810742435690564) How we use info for AI at Meta We’re always improving [AI at Meta](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/privacy/genai). To do this, we want you to know that we'll use [public information](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/?subpage=3.subpage.3-PublicContentWhatContent) such as public posts and comments from accounts of people aged 18 or older and your interactions with AI at Meta features. We’ll use this information on the basis of legitimate interests to develop and improve generative AI models for AI at Meta. You have the right to [object](https://www.facebook.com/help/contact/6359191084165019) to the use of your information for these purposes. If you submit an objection, we’ll send an email confirming that we won't use your interactions with AI at Meta features or your public information from Meta Products for future development and improvement of generative AI models for AI at Meta. [Learn about how models are trained](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/dialog/how-generative-ai-models-work). If you've already objected, you don't need to submit another request. These changes go into effect on May 27, 2025. [Read the new policy.](https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy/version/9168837699838785/)
